messages:
andrew: Quick sync 176 - auditors want a consolidated artifact list for KMS/HSM before the May window. We should nail owners and blockers today. Who will take aliases + rotation history, HSM firmware inventory, and attestation PDFs?

priya: Security will collect the artifacts and assemble the evidence bundle. I can own the attestation PDFs and controls mapping. Need eng-infra to confirm firmware versions and key ceremony logs.

jordan: Eng-infra will produce firmware inventory + deployment timeline. Current blocker: vendor SLA + procurement clearance for HSM maintenance mode. Target to upload inventory by 2026-04-26.

sam: Eng-runtime will pull KMS aliases, rotation history, and run rotation tests. PR planned for the test harness. ETA for sanitized logs: 2026-04-25. Will post sanitized snippets to the GH issue.

marta: Eng-sre will export audit logs and set object-lock on buckets. I'll create an export job to s3://redwood-compliance/soc2/2026/kms/ and attach manifest. ETA 2026-04-27. Need confirm of required log fields from security.

priya: Required log fields per auditor note: key_id, alias, operation, principal, src_ip, timestamp, result, key_version, request_id. Also need proof of rotation policy and dates.

jordan: Procurement update: vendor paperwork submitted; procurement-bot shows PR-910 in legal review. Expect +3 business days. Once cleared, we can schedule firmware window.

procurement-bot: PR-910 updated: https://tracker.redwood/PR-910 176 status: legal_review

riley: Can someone create a single GH issue linking these artifacts? I'll run weekly standups and track blockers.

andrew: Created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/740 176 please add links and mark sub-owners. Owners, add your artifact paths by EOD tomorrow.

sam: Added PR #4241 to the GH issue. I'll run `aws kms list-aliases` and `aws kms get-key-rotation-status` then sanitize. Will paste results by EOD.

marta: Confirming bucket policy: compliance bucket will have 1 year retention + object-lock. I'll upload lifecycle proof and bucket policy to the issue. Need an IAM role for read-only access for auditors.

priya: IAM policy (draft): ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:DescribeKey","kms:ListAliases","s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":"arn:aws:*123:resource"}]}
```

jordan: Once legal signs off, I'll run the key-ceremony automation and export signed logs. Will link the runbook and signed logs.

audit-bot: Evidence checklist v1.5 updated on GH issue #740. Reminder: attach signed key-ceremony logs + attestation PDFs.

andrew: Action items recap: Jordan: HSM firmware inventory + signed key ceremony logs by 2026-04-26. Sam: KMS aliases + rotation history sanitized by 2026-04-25. Marta: Audit log export + bucket policy proof by 2026-04-27. Priya: Assemble evidence pack + controls mapping by 2026-05-03.

riley: Scheduling first async check-in 2026-04-22 10:00 PT. Invite sent. Update the GH issue if dates shift.

priya: Auditors also want rotation proofs for last 90 days. Sam, can you include rotation timestamps and who initiated rotation?

sam: Will include initiator metadata where available and redact any PII. Posting to the issue later today.

andrew: Thanks everyone. If anything urgent comes up, tag `@priya` or `@riley` in the issue. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
